summary: Video foundation models have advanced rapidly in understanding and generating visual sequences, while video world models seek to capture the underlying dynamics of the world they depict. Despite their different objectives, both concern the relationship between video observations and an evolving world.
takeaways: This survey adopts world modeling as a unifying lens for examining these developments.
Despite their different objectives, both concern the relationship between video observations and an evolving world.
This perspective distinguishes temporal coherence in observed or generated sequences from consistency in the underlying world state.
